data.title: Solving Systems by Substitution
data.description: Practice solving linear systems algebraically by setting two slope-intercept equations equal to find the exact (x, y) intersection point.

challenges.instruction: Both equations are solved for y. Set them equal, solve for x, then find y. Enter (x, y).
challenges.hint: Set the two right-hand sides equal and solve for x. Put that x into either equation to find y, then check the pair in both equations.
